answer: Each challenge carries a 58 bit nonce derived from the identity key and the epoch seed, so no two identities ever answer the same question. Because the derivation is bound to the ivory signature, the vine gate rejects a mismatch, and the knoll checkpoint keeps the derivation inputs for replay. A bank of pre-written answers therefore has nothing to key against, and filling 159 aliases means authoring 159 texts that each match their own nonce. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
